prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 主流旗舰手机屏幕与价格参数 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "型号" spans 1 col × 2 row; "屏幕" spans 2 col × 1 row; "价格" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 55px · one-line width 172px
  col 2: header "屏幕 › 尺寸" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 74px
  col 3: header "屏幕 › 技术" · longest unbreakable word 87px · one-line width 545px
  col 4: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 81px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 467px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 466px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较主流旗舰手机的屏幕尺寸、显示技术与价格。","reading":"读者先按型号定位，再横向查看同一款手机的屏幕和价格；也会纵向比较尺寸、技术和价格。技术描述较长，通常决定行高，可利用这些行高容纳型号换行。","groups":["屏幕尺寸与屏幕技术同属“屏幕”表头，分别用于快速比较尺寸和阅读具体技术配置。","型号是行标识，价格是独立的比较指标；两者需要便于沿列扫描。"],"keep_intact":["手机型号中的品牌、系列和型号标识应尽量完整，避免在标识内部断行。","屏幕尺寸数值与“英寸”应尽量放在一起。","价格数值及其货币单位应尽量保持完整。","屏幕技术中的 OLED、AMOLED、LTPO、120Hz 等缩写和数值应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["屏幕技术描述可在技术名称、特性和标点之间自然换行。","较长型号可在品牌与系列名称之间换行，并利用技术描述形成的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [110, 95, 159, 102] · table 467×922px · row heights [39, 39, 145, 145, 118, 145, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [115, 95, 155, 101] · table 467×922px · row heights [39, 39, 145, 145, 118, 145, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [125, 95, 144, 102] · table 467×974px · row heights [39, 39, 145, 145, 118, 145, 171, 171] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"尺寸与价格均保持单行，便于纵向比较；技术列相对宽，六款手机的技术描述都控制在五行以内。表头层级清晰，各行也能作为整体横向阅读。","problems":"部分型号在系列名称中间换行，如 iPhone 15 与 Pro 分开；三星型号占三行。技术描述也有较零碎的换行，如“尼特”被拆开。","cause":"型号列为110px，可用文字宽度89px，容不下部分完整系列名称；技术列为159px，可用138px，长描述仍需多次换行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"型号列略宽，三星 Galaxy S24 Ultra 缩为两行；尺寸保持单行，表头清楚，总高度与 r2A 相同。","problems":"多数价格的“起”被单独挤到第二行，破坏价格列的扫描节奏；技术描述仍有较多零碎换行，iPhone 型号仍在 Pro 前断行。","cause":"价格列从102px减至101px，低于部分完整价格所需宽度；技术列缩至155px，型号列虽增至115px，仍不足以容纳部分完整系列名称。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"型号列较宽，三星型号保持两行；尺寸和价格均为单行，便于比较。","problems":"技术列过窄，后两行增至六行，整表明显变高；技术词组被拆得更零碎，型号列换来的收益不足以抵消技术列的拥挤。","cause":"型号列增至125px，使技术列缩至144px，可用文字宽度仅123px；价格列保留102px则让价格恢复单行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"技术优先","widths":[105,95,164,102],"change":"以 r2A 为基础，将型号列缩窄5px并全部交给技术列，保留尺寸和价格的单行宽度；检验技术描述能否减少碎行，同时观察型号是否出现更不自然的断行。"},{"name":"型号与技术折中","widths":[115,95,154,102],"change":"保留 r2B 较宽的型号列，将价格恢复至102px以容纳完整价格，技术列再缩1px；检验三星型号两行与价格单行能否兼得。"},{"name":"压缩尺寸列","widths":[115,90,159,102],"change":"将尺寸列缩窄5px，把空间交给型号列，同时保留 r2A 的技术列和价格列宽度；检验最长尺寸是否仍能单行，从而改善型号换行而不增加技术列拥挤。"}]}
